summary: Living space is mostly tidy but features breakable decor and accessible potted plant hazards.

hazards.title: Fragile Tall Vase on Low Table
hazards.detail: Tall ceramic vase within easy reach of toddlers or pets can easily be knocked over.
fixSteps: Relocate tall ceramic vase to a higher shelf or stable surface.
Secure base with museum putty if keeping on low furniture.

hazards.title: Unprotected Indoor Ficus Tree
hazards.detail: Ficus foliage and soil are accessible to pets and young children who may ingest them.
fixSteps: Verify plant variety is non-toxic or place beyond pet reach.
Cover exposed potting soil to prevent pets digging and ingesting.

hazards.title: Loose Glass Cloche on Floor/Shelf
hazards.detail: Glass decor under low table shelf poses shatter and injury risks if kicked or grabbed.
fixSteps: Remove glass decor items from lower open storage beneath table.
Replace with shatterproof baskets or storage bins.

hazards.title: Unsecured Table Candle
hazards.detail: Small candle on coffee table is accessible to curious pets or small hands.
fixSteps: Store candles out of reach when unattended.
